# PDF.js

Mozilla PDF.js 5.6.205, distributed under the included Apache-2.0 license.
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v5.6.205
Distribution: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/5.6.205

The unmodified minified browser library, worker and standard fonts are served locally. Font licenses are retained in `standard_fonts/`. No CDN,
remote viewer, scripting sandbox or document text extraction is enabled. The
file workspace renders PDF pages into a canvas with scripting and evaluation
disabled. It stores annotation overlays separately from original file bytes.
